input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law and exclusive Singapore courts, which is outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and would put us in a foreign forum. It also directly conflicts with Section 28.2, which already grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County. The minimal fix is to change the governing law in 28.1 to New York (our preferred position), leaving 28.2's New York venue and 28.3's escalation process intact.

ops.oldText: governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
ops.newText: governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have replaced the Singapore law and courts selection with New York law, which is our standard governing-law position and removes the direct conflict with the exclusive New York County jurisdiction already agreed in Section 28.2. If New York is not workable, we can accept Delaware or California law and courts, or English law with the courts of London.
proposal.summary: Change governing law in 28.1 from Singapore to New York, aligning with the New York venue in 28.2.
